install_script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
setup_root=/workspace/.medusa-environment
mkdir -p "$setup_root/bin"
export npm_config_cache="$setup_root/npm-cache"
npm install --prefix "$setup_root/toolchain" --no-audit --no-fund node@22.23.3
cat > "$setup_root/bin/yarn" <<'YARN'
#!/bin/sh
exec /workspace/.medusa-environment/toolchain/node_modules/node/bin/node /workspace/medusa/.yarn/releases/yarn-3.2.1.cjs "$@"
YARN
chmod +x "$setup_root/bin/yarn"
cat > "$setup_root/activate.sh" <<'ACTIVATE'
export PATH=/workspace/.medusa-environment/toolchain/node_modules/node/bin:/workspace/.medusa-environment/bin:$PATH
export npm_config_cache=/workspace/.medusa-environment/npm-cache
export YARN_GLOBAL_FOLDER=/workspace/.medusa-environment/yarn-global
export YARN_CHECKSUM_BEHAVIOR=throw
export YARN_NM_MODE=hardlinks-local
export YARN_HTTP_PROXY="${HTTP_PROXY:-${http_proxy:-}}"
export YARN_HTTPS_PROXY="${HTTPS_PROXY:-${https_proxy:-}}"
ACTIVATE
source "$setup_root/activate.sh"
cd /workspace/medusa
yarn install --immutable --inline-builds
yarn turbo run build --filter=@medusajs/utils... --concurrency=2 --no-daemon

# Retained MIT SaaS coding fork (requires the published workspace snapshot).
if [ -f /workspace/.medusa-baseline/mit-source/saas/BASELINE.json ]; then
  source /workspace/.medusa-baseline/activate.sh
  export XDG_CONFIG_HOME=/workspace/.medusa-baseline/config
  mkdir -p "$XDG_CONFIG_HOME"
  cd /workspace/.medusa-baseline/mit-source
  yarn install --immutable --inline-builds
  yarn turbo run build --filter=integration-tests-http... --concurrency=3 --no-daemon
  yarn workspace @medusajs/loyalty-plugin build:plugin
  node saas/check-baseline.cjs
fi

# M3 native Admin/reference storefront build; no test reset or production migration.
if [ -f /workspace/.medusa-baseline/mit-source/saas/storefront/package.json ]; then
  source /workspace/.medusa-baseline/activate.sh
  cd /workspace/.medusa-baseline/mit-source
  SAAS_ARTIFACT_DIR=/workspace/.medusa-baseline/m3-build bash saas/build-m3.sh
fi


# Current MIT SaaS application: store-saas/saas-mvp.
# Preserve existing checkouts and local work. Clone only when the path is absent.
if [ ! -e /workspace/store-saas ]; then
  git clone --branch saas-mvp --single-branch https://github.com/victors2021/store-saas.git /workspace/store-saas
fi
if [ ! -f /workspace/store-saas/saas/BASELINE.json ]; then
  echo "Current store-saas checkout is missing; restore or clone it without replacing existing local work" >&2
  exit 1
fi
saas_setup_root=/workspace/.store-saas-environment
mkdir -p "$saas_setup_root/bin" "$saas_setup_root/config"
cat > "$saas_setup_root/bin/yarn" <<'SAAS_YARN'
#!/bin/sh
exec /workspace/.medusa-environment/toolchain/node_modules/node/bin/node /workspace/store-saas/.yarn/releases/yarn-3.2.1.cjs "$@"
SAAS_YARN
chmod +x "$saas_setup_root/bin/yarn"
cat > "$saas_setup_root/activate.sh" <<'SAAS_ACTIVATE'
source /workspace/.medusa-environment/activate.sh
export PATH=/workspace/.store-saas-environment/bin:$PATH
export YARN_CACHE_FOLDER=/workspace/medusa/.yarn/cache
export NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4096
export XDG_CONFIG_HOME=/workspace/.store-saas-environment/config
SAAS_ACTIVATE
source "$saas_setup_root/activate.sh"
cd /workspace/store-saas
yarn install --immutable --inline-builds
yarn turbo run build --filter=integration-tests-http... --filter=@medusajs/payment-stripe... --concurrency=3 --no-daemon
yarn workspace @medusajs/loyalty-plugin build:plugin
node saas/check-baseline.cjs
SAAS_ARTIFACT_DIR=/workspace/.store-saas-verification/setup bash saas/build-m3.sh
# No production migration, test reset, provider calls, or live-money operation here.
start_skill:
Current coding checkout: /workspace/store-saas, branch saas-mvp, origin victors2021/store-saas.
Read README.md, docs/saas/14-M4-IMPLEMENTATION.md, docs/saas/15-M4-CODE-REVIEW.md and saas/M4-README.md first.
Use source /workspace/.store-saas-environment/activate.sh and cd /workspace/store-saas.
Original /workspace/medusa develop and historical /workspace/.medusa-baseline/mit-source are references: preserve all local work, historical evidence, root MIT LICENSE/manifest/lockfile and storefront license/lockfile. Do not code in or reset those old checkouts. Do not create worktrees unless requested.
Read the cloud-environment runtime skill before managed networking/Docker work. Use the existing session proxy and CA; do not extract credentials or bypass network denials.
Install uses Node 22.23.3, bundled root Yarn 3.2.1 and storefront Yarn 4.12.0. Setup has already been tested in the installed workspace; fresh snapshot restoration/new-machine installation is still unverified.
For verification: bash saas/start-services.sh, then SAAS_ARTIFACT_DIR=/workspace/.store-saas-verification/m4 bash saas/verify-m4.sh. Docker PG/Redis are pinned and loopback-only. The tests use explicitly marked fixed disposable databases; shared fixtures must run serially. Never redirect reset flags to live data. Python Playwright and system Chromium are required.
M4 implements tenant Stripe test credentials, native capture/refund, manual fulfillment/cancel/stock, raw signed callbacks, durable retry and currency totals with native Admin extensions. Local SDK/protocol/DB/browser evidence is not actual Stripe sandbox acceptance.
Production-like start requires the separately migrated restricted-role database, stable SaaS runtime values and independent 32-byte hex SAAS_PAYMENT_KEY. Run node saas/migrate-m4-command.cjs with a separate migration account, initialize existing M2 tenants explicitly only when needed, build, then node saas/start-m4.cjs behind reviewed TLS/Host ingress. Never auto-reset, migrate unknown data, generate replacement persistent keys or deploy publicly. SaaS and Stripe backend secrets must stay out of the Next child environment.
Direct runtime inputs: SAAS_DATABASE_URL, SAAS_BASE_DOMAIN, SAAS_PLATFORM_ACTOR_ID, SAAS_JWT_SECRET, SAAS_CONTEXT_SECRET, SAAS_IDENTITY_SECRET, SAAS_PLATFORM_KEY, SAAS_OBJECT_ROOT, SAAS_PAYMENT_KEY. Supply secrets securely, never values in source/chat/logs.
Optional actual sandbox test inputs: SAAS_STRIPE_ALPHA_API_KEY, SAAS_STRIPE_ALPHA_PUBLISHABLE_KEY, SAAS_STRIPE_ALPHA_WEBHOOK_SECRET, SAAS_STRIPE_ALPHA_ACCOUNT_ID and corresponding BRAVO names. They are process inputs for saas/m4-sandbox.cjs, not global storefront Stripe keys. Two distinct sk_test/pk_test merchant accounts are required. Missing inputs yield pending/exit 2 before touching a database.
Actual independent Stripe API, official reachable TLS callback delivery and browser Elements/3DS must be verified separately. Current runtime has no configured merchant keys. Network changes in this draft require publishing and are not already applied. No live key or real-money test is authorized.
M5: paid-order paths during suspension, quotas/rate limits, fairness/monitoring, coordinated cleanup, backups/key recovery/deployment rollback. M6: independent security/license/dependency/performance and release acceptance. All AI/helpdesk/CRM/marketing is phase two. Separate merchant UI remains paused.
Save subsequent evidence only under new current-phase directories; preserve M0-M3 archived files. Prior authorization covers committing/pushing SaaS source and docs to victors2021/store-saas/saas-mvp; verify remote SHA before reporting delivery.
Repository membership was deliberately preserved: historical duplicate/local checkouts must not be removed or origins rewritten solely to replace the list. Publish the reviewed environment configuration/snapshot to activate it; draft saving alone does not prove a fresh-task restore.
